description: This file defines an internal interface for accessing cluster manifest data and a class representing updates to the cluster manifest within the Orleans distributed application framework.

classes.name: ClusterManifestUpdate
classes.description: Represents an update to the cluster manifest, including version, silo manifests, and whether all active servers are included.

methods.name: GetClusterManifest
methods.description: Retrieves the current cluster manifest asynchronously.

methods.name: GetClusterManifestUpdate
methods.description: Retrieves an updated cluster manifest if it is newer than the specified previous version.
